coverage.packaging_tin_runtime_policy: Named packaging-dependent meat Tin rows are applied only when the user explicitly selects the exact FSSAI article identity and the matching container material. PMSV does not infer the named meat identity from a broader FoSCoS product. Generic canned-food and 'Foods not specified' fallbacks remain disabled.
coverage.chapter_2_7_review_note: Hard Candy and Cocoa Powder retain existing exact Version IX profiles. Build 423 adds Ice Lollies/Edible Ices using the exact article 'Ice-cream, iced lollies and similar frozen confections' (Lead 1.0 mg/kg; Arsenic 0.5 mg/kg). Soft Candy, Lozenges, Chewing/Bubble Gum, Chocolate, Dry Cocoa-Sugar Mixes and Cocoa Mass/Liquor/Cake remain explicitly fail-closed because no exact current Version IX finished-product article was found.
coverage.chapter_2_6_taxonomic_rule_policy: Direct Version IX Fish/Crustaceans/Cephalopods/Bivalve Molluscs/All fishery products articles only; source-literal Arsenic 76/86 rows are not promoted; generic finfish Mercury remains species-gated.

chapter_2_6_gelatin_chromium_precedence.reason: The shared Gelatin profile already has the exact product/substance Chromium row at 10 mg/kg. The broader fishery-product row is not duplicated onto the shared generic/fish-gelatin profile.

coverage.chapter_2_6_review_note: All 24 Chapter 2.6 catalogue products reviewed. Direct taxonomy, all-fishery Chromium, bivalve biotoxins, smoked-fish PAH and exact histamine product-category routes are operational. Mercury species class, PCB habitat class and raw/frozen histamine species remain conditional. Fish Oil, Edible Fish Powder, Sturgeon Caviar and fish gelatin retain only proven exact rules and do not inherit broad fallback categories.
coverage.last_runtime_fix_note: Added exact fermented-milk standardized-product contaminant profile for Yoghurt/Flavoured Dahi. Methyl Mercury remains the official all-food rule; Lead is now product-specific at 0.02 mg/kg for secondary milk products as consumed. Milk-product pesticide MRLs and prohibited veterinary-substance rules remain separate.
coverage.chapter_2_5_commodity_review_policy: Exact official pesticide commodity rows are candidate references only; do not auto transfer commodity MRLs to any FoSCoS meat/egg product without verified edible matrix, processing, species and residue-basis applicability.
coverage.chapter_2_4_commodity_review_policy: All 77 catalogue Chapter 2.4 identities examined for official Version IX commodity pesticide/article candidates, with no auto-application; raw, milled, oilseed and composite matrices kept separate.
